g.text: 8-Finger Chromatic Isolation · Opposite-Shift Pinky Rules · Anchor Nubs on [F] & [J]
Index fingers rest permanently on tactile homing keys [F] and [J]. Reaches always return to base before the next key stroke.
Never press Shift with the same hand typing the letter. Left-hand caps use Right Shift pinky; right-hand caps use Left Shift pinky.
Press Space with the thumb opposite the hand that struck the previous character. Eliminates fatigue and doubles rhythm cadence.
